thread:
jordan: Hey — customer acme-finance-prod on Private (vpc-us-east-1) hit repeated tool invocation failures. API returns 400 + JSON schema validation errors. Payload has billing.amount as a string and an unexpected top-level promo_code. Also noticed selected_tool came back as 'invoicing' which is wrong for this call. Can we repro and patch quickly? :eyes:

maria: Can you paste the exact curl + response body? Also need request-id from logs.

jordan: curl snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.internal/v1/tools/invoke \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"tool":"payments","input":{"billing":{"amount":"100.00","currency":"USD"},"customer_id":"acct_123"},"meta":{"trace":"ui-checkout"},"promo_code":"SPRING10","invoice_id":null}'
```
Response (400):
```json
{
  "errors": [
    {"path":"billing.amount","message":"expected number"},
    {"path":"promo_code","message":"additional property not allowed"}
  ],
  "selected_tool": "invoicing"
}
```
Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d - I attached logs to the ticket.

maria: Thanks. Two separate problems: (1) schema type mismatch: our function schema for payments.billing.amount is "number" so strings fail. (2) additionalProperties: top-level promo_code is disallowed. The selected_tool being invoicing smells like tool-routing picked up the presence of invoice_id/promo_code and routed incorrectly.

dev-support-bot: Logged request req_0a1b2c3d, created trace link: https://logs.internal/req_0a1b2c3d

maria: Repro steps I'm using locally: 1) run gateway in dev mode 2) POST payload above 3) note JSONSchema error from validator (ajv) 4) inspect routing decision: route service passes payload to model that scored invoicing higher because of top-level invoice_id/promo_code.

jordan: Customer says their frontend SDK serializes numeric amounts as strings to preserve cents across languages, and they recently added a promo_code at top-level for analytics. Their SDK added null invoice_id in some flows. So it's a client-side change that caused both failures.

anna: This is on Private — we can push a gateway compatibility shim quickly. Suggestions: coercion rule for billing.amount (coerce strings that match ^\d+(\.\d+)?$ to number), and a whitelist/stripper for known top-level keys per tool (strip promo_code when invoking payments). Add telemetry so we can see how many requests we coerce. SLA-wise, broken calls are causing retries and increased tail latency for the customer.

maria: Agreed. Quick plan: (A) hotfix gateway: coerce billing.amount -> number for payments tool and strip unknown top-level keys (promo_code) for payments calls; (B) add a warning log and metric tag (shim_coercion=true); (C) update function schema docs and SDK guidance to encourage numeric amounts or explicit casting. I'll open a PR and request an expedited canary.

jordan: Repro checklist for ops: 1) POST the curl above to gateway canary 2) verify response is 200 and selected_tool is payments 3) verify req_0a1b2c3d shows shim_coercion=true in logs and no JSON schema errors 4) notify customer to roll back SDK change or upgrade to patched SDK. I've included the customer contact.

dev-support-bot: Created incident INC-2026 and linked request req_0a1b2c3d.

maria: I'll aim to get the gateway hotfix deployed to canary in ~2h, full rollout after canary looks clean (~6h). If someone from SRE can watch metrics for error rate and selected_tool shift, please ack.

anna: I'll watch. Assigning @ops and @maria. :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks team — ping me when canary is green and I'll coordinate with customer.

acme-integration: FYI we reproduced on our side, will hold releases until your patch is in.

maria: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/gateway/pulls/2491 - includes coercion + stripping + unit tests.

anna: Great. Marking this thread as escalated and adding to postmortem if customer sees impact beyond this.
